purpose: Execute the atomic create-circular-pattern operation within the MA-19 boundary: One circular array effect for unlinked transient body instances. It copies the supplied body count times, preserves the source, applies known axis-rotation matrices to copies after index 0, rejects periodic duplicate angular positions even after wrapped turns, and does not create native associative pattern features, attach bodies, or edit components/occurrences.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-circular-pattern and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A closed nonempty transient source body; attached DesignBody and component/occurrence variants are excluded.

inputs.name: axis_origin_mm
inputs.description: Finite point on the circular-array axis in millimetres.

inputs.name: axis_direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero axis direction; normalized by the shared direction helper.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Finite integer-valued instance count; the source location is included, but every returned instance is an independent copy.

inputs.name: step_angle_degrees
inputs.description: Signed finite angular increment in degrees; cumulative returned angles are index * step_angle_degrees.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for comparing every copied instance volume with the source volume.

preconditions: axis_origin_mm and axis_direction are finite; axis_direction is nonzero.
count is a finite integer >= 2 and booleans are rejected.
step_angle_degrees and volume_tolerance_mm3 are finite; tolerance is nonnegative.
The cumulative angular positions modulo 360 degrees are pairwise distinct, including positions after more than one turn.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {instances: array<transient Modeler.Body>, angles_degrees: array<number>, source_policy: "preserved", association: "independent"}; angles include 0 for the copied source location.

postconditions: Exactly count independent transient instances are returned, including a copy at zero angle.
The supplied source body is not transformed or consumed.
angles_degrees contains count cumulative signed angles [index * step_angle_degrees].
Every returned instance passes require_transient/assert_closed and preserves source volume within volume_tolerance_mm3.
The returned source_policy is preserved and association is independent.

implementation.notes: Execute the atomic create-circular-pattern operation within the MA-19 boundary: One circular array effect for unlinked transient body instances. recovery.action: Supply a fresh valid transient source and corrected finite parameters; no model mutation has occurred.
Discard all partial transient instances and rerun from the unchanged source; no rollback is implemented.
